title: Session transfer
subtitle: Move native provider session files between computers.

overview.description: Move native session files between devices without changing their provider format.
overview.experimental-warning: Experimental routes are enabled in this release. Keep backups and verify imported sessions before relying on them.
overview.unverified-warning: Untested provider and operating-system combinations stay unavailable to protect your sessions.
overview.before-description: Install and enable the destination providers first. Lumora skips missing providers and unresolved workspaces instead of overwriting native data.
overview.load-error: Session transfer information could not be loaded.
overview.archive-open-error: The session archive could not be opened.
overview.history-error: The transfer history could not be refreshed.

guide.title: How transfer works
guide.export: Export copies the selected providers' original session files.
guide.import: Import places compatible session files in the selected provider location.
guide.accounts: Use the same provider account on the destination computer.
guide.providers: Install a provider before importing its sessions.

export.title: Export sessions
export.choose-description: Only stopped sessions with a verified provider route can be selected.

export.ready-count: {count, plural, one {# ready to export} other {# ready to export}}
export.excluded-count: {count, plural, one {# session excluded} other {# sessions excluded}}
export.encrypt-description: Recommended for session files and transcripts.
export.unencrypted-warning: Anyone with this archive can read its session files.
export.choose-native: Choose where to save the archive in the native dialog.
export.prepare-error: Lumora could not prepare the selected sessions.
export.create-error: The session archive could not be created.
export.cancel-error: Lumora could not cancel this export.

import.title: Import sessions
import.skip-uninstalled: Skip providers that are not installed
import.provider-description: Select the installed providers to import. Unsupported providers stay safely inside the archive.
import.workspace-description: Map each source workspace to an existing folder, or skip its sessions.
import.nothing-ready: Nothing is ready to import. Go back and review provider and workspace choices.
import.preparing-sessions: Preparing the selected sessions for import.
import.complete-guidance: Imported sessions are now available in Lumora.
import.cancelled-guidance: No additional sessions will be imported.
import.failed-guidance: Review the archive and try again when ready.
